sources.title: Claude Opus 5 — Benchmarks, Specs & Release Date
sources.snippet: Claude Opus 5 Claude Opus 5 is an AI model released by Anthropic on Friday, Jul 24 2026, 24 days after Claude Sonnet 5. It has a 1M token context window. Benchmark results (shown below) cover Gray Swan IPI, FrontierCode v1.1 (Main), Supabase Evals, Frontier-Bench v0.1, Humanity's Last Exam, ARC-AGI-3, and 13 more.

sources.title: Claude Opus 5 - Amazon Bedrock
sources.snippet: Claude Opus 5 is Anthropic's most advanced Opus model, powering long-running agents while delivering improvements in coding and professional work.

sources.title: Introducing Claude Opus 5 \ Anthropic
sources.snippet: Claude Opus 5 is a strong agentic coding model built for long-running, multi-step work. It deeply understands your codebase, holds the thread across complex tasks, and pins down requirements for feature development and bug-fixing more effectively than Opus 4.8.
